h4#length. Length and volume 

* !post #5397131: [[very short hair]]  - hair that does not go past the jaw
* !post #6290364: [[short hair]]  - hair that does not go past the shoulders
* !post #4402781: [[medium hair]] - hair that is (around) shoulder length
* !post #10351427: [[long hair]] - hair that goes from the shoulders to the waist 
* !post #2336560: [[very long hair]] - hair that goes from the waist to the feet
* !post #9658670: [[absurdly long hair]] - hair that goes past the feet
* !post #4568567: [[big hair]] - hair that is notably voluminous or thick
* !post #2235813: [[bald]] (if female, [[bald female]]) - no hair at all 
* !post #5860667: [[balding]] - mostly bald, but has sparse amounts of hair
